title: Sagalee Ogummaa
intro: Sagaleen ogummaa lallaafaan yeroo tokko gorsa yeroo irra darbee qooddachaa ture. Lakkoofsi kun hubannoo gadi fagootiin kan eebbifame yoo ta’u, barumsa gatii guddaa qabu kan namoota qajeelfama hawwan hundaaf ibsaa ta’ee hafe dabarseera. Jechoota bara baraan jiraatan kana duuba eenyummaa jiru hiikuu dandeessaa?
clues: Rabbi irraa qananii gadi fagoo, kennaa qalbii fi sammuu koo ibse naaf kenname.
Qabeenya hunda caalaa gatii guddaa qabu kan ani qabu qooddachuuf hawwiidhaan gara mucaa koo isa jaalladhutti garagale.
Haqa dhabuun inni guddaan Waaqa dhugaa Tokkicha wajjin michuu dhaabuu akka ta’e akeekkachiiseera.
Ulfaatinni sanyii sanaaficaa, dhagaa keessa ykn samii bira darbee dhokatellee Rabbiin akka itti gaafatamu yaadachiise.
Abboomamuun dhimma qajeelummaa qofa irratti ta’us, warraaf dirqama akkan qabaadhu qajeelfama kenneera.
Amala salphaa barsiiseera: lafa irratti gad of deebisuudhaan deemi sagalee kees giddu galeessa godhadhu; sababiin isaas sagaleen cimaan sagalee harree ti.

trial.label: Yaali / Taatee
options: Mucaa isaatiif gorsa gadi fagoo kennuu
Lolaa guddaa jalaa bahuuf doonii ijaaruu
trial.answer: Mucaa isaatiif gorsa gadi fagoo kennuu

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Gorsi isaa macaafa qulqulluu waaqayyoo keessatti kan hin duune ture
Raajii fi seera haaraan isaaf kenname
Mootummaa balʼaa irratti bulchaa cimaa taʼe
outcome.answer: Gorsi isaa macaafa qulqulluu waaqayyoo keessatti kan hin duune ture

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
